SYCOPHANT, an appellation given by the ancient A-
theman to thole who informed the exporation of figs
contary to bay, and hence it is full field in general for all inforners, parafities, flattreets, chests, &c.

parsed.faithful: SYCOPHANT, an appellation given by the ancient A- thenians to thole who informed of the exportation of figs contrary to law; and hence it is still used in general for all informers, parasites, flatterers, cheats, &c.
parsed.modern: SYCOPHANT, an appellation given by the ancient Athenians to those who informed of the exportation of figs contrary to law; and hence it is still used in general for all informers, parasites, flatterers, cheats, &c.
